notes.title: Patch Notes - Update 0.25.14
notes.content:

notes.title: Patch Notes - Update 0.25.5
notes.content:
[b]Hello Bees,[/b]

This week has been very busy, and today we have some improvements for the game. Enjoy!

[h2]Bug Fixes - Update 0.25.5[/h2]

Fixed: Weapon menu could be opened even at game start.

Fixed: Bees kept spawning even after their spawner was destroyed.

Fixed: Certain northern walls could be passed through.

Fixed: Player could move during the eagle cutscene.

Fixed: Fire flower could trap the bee and deal constant damage.

Fixed: Queen bee flying to objects inside combs and other hives when not intended.

Fixed: Popup issues on in-game objects.

Fixed: Night waves now trigger correctly, preventing nights from passing without attacks.

Fixed: Bees that died would respawn unable to attack.

Fixed: Particle effects during the wolf battle.

Fixed: Wolf’s area damage lacked proper depth and visual clarity.

Fixed: During the queen tutorial, dialogue would not work until leaving and re-entering (trigger adjusted).

Fixed: Sounds and actions still active after death.

Fixed: Grandma’s shop could trap the player and had item selection errors.

Fixed: Name selection with controllers; random names now adapted for each language.

Fixed: Laptop not rendering or interacting with the bee.

Fixed: Trigger to talk to the queen still failed under certain conditions.

Fixed: First movement tutorial appeared only in English.

Fixed: Missing translation on the name selection screen.

Fixed: Weapons loading incorrect or non-existent honey.

Fixed: Tutorial arrow activating at the wrong time and repositioned to face the player.

Fixed: Camera lowering during egg placement.

Fixed: After the weapon tutorial, it was impossible to drop or fire the weapon.

Fixed: Ant deaths not being registered.

Fixed: Honey inspection and abilities tab displaying errors.

Fixed: Grandma’s flying coins behaving incorrectly.

Tutorial re-ordered: battle segment moved further ahead, with gathering integrated into combat phase.

Added a chance for the queen bee to be captured.

Added destruction animation for pulley wood planks.

Added weapon unlock notification.

Reduced time before the frog begins attacking.

Revised frog battle music.

Implemented system to automatically assign bees to the correct weapons.

Weapons now have personalized names.

notes.title: 🐝 Update 0.25: …With Guns, and Ants, and More 🐝
notes.content:
[h2][b]🐝 Update 0.25: …With Guns, and Ants, and More 🐝[/b][/h2][p][/p][p][b]Hey there, little bees! 🐝[/b][/p][p][/p][p]Today we’re buzzing with the [b]biggest update yet[/b] for Honey Bee, now officially called [b]“Honey Bee With Guns”[/b] (a name that finally tells it like it is… and also sounds pretty cool when we tell people we’re making “that game with bees and guns,”😅).[/p][p]If you want to jump straight to the juicy spoilers, just scroll down a bit. Just a heads-up: this version [b]is not compatible[/b] with previous save files.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44982818/2e9a6313a23ef85b9c8cd1c7e1cd0fc068a7bbfc.png"][/img][/p][hr][/hr][p][/p][h3][b]1 - Visual Improvements[/b][/h3][p]The first thing you’ll notice is that we’ve given the entire game a visual overhaul![/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44982818/f15301c23d1cec8d1a9dbcc98bfdd36843e6055a.jpg"][/img]  [/p][p]New textures, new effects, more particles, more life, more chaos, the world of Honey Bee With Guns is more alive than ever.[/p][p]Our main bee also got a much needed visual upgrade with a brand new model, making everything smoother and more expressive.[/p][p]We recently showed off a demo at [b]Gamescom Latam[/b], where attendees got an early taste of this update. We’re super grateful for all the feedback we received, about the visuals, mechanics, audio, and more. Thanks to everyone who stopped by![/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44982818/9ffaef6f21b4be10c7a13ee0f281922e8b7da656.jpg"][/img]  [/p][hr][/hr][p][/p][h3][b]2 - Tower Defense Mode[/b][/h3][p]The hive must be protected... even from afar. In this wild world, defending your home is still the top priority. But now, you can do it in [b]way more creative ways[/b].[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44982818/df782c570f94acd02eb2ff57c7ef3f26839b1bfc.png"][/img]  [/p][p]Bees can now [b]carry and use weapons[/b] like mobile towers. That means you can secure key areas even while you're far from home.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44982818/7b2b0de473f3d12bcbe827b2d843e03c003b9f39.png"][/img]  [/p][p]You can also equip multiple collected or unlocked weapons, pistols, SMGs, whatever you’ve got lying around. Your bees will handle it.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44982818/09252a3a3969003326d7dcd6fb7c8c5e505d451e.jpg"][/img]  [/p][p]This adds a whole new layer of [b]tactical gameplay[/b], custom loadouts, smarter defenses, and more dynamic battles. But remember: more towers means more bees. More bees means more honey.[/p][p][/p][hr][/hr][p][/p][h3][b]3 - Home Sweet Home (Literally)[/b][/h3][p]We’ve made a bunch of improvements to hive management, rebalancing costs and resources, and giving the hive a brand-new look.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44982818/837e139b17312bb104dbf607310f4fc138d6059e.jpg"][/img]  [/p][hr][/hr][p][/p][h3][b]4 - New UI & Magical Touches[/b][/h3][p]The [b]UI has been reworked[/b]!
 From the color palette to item layout and interaction flow, we’ve added little polish everywhere to improve your experience.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44982818/072ae83ea7ce8004d6482f174ce08c5a39f5606e.png"][/img]  [/p][hr][/hr][p][/p][h3][b]5 - Ants, and More Bugs[/b][/h3][p]Other insects can now interact with you, sometimes as friends, sometimes as foes.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44982818/d2d19ffa99a74b33065bb049f4af0192a30403b7.png"][/img]  [/p][p]But what are they doing? Where do they live? What are they planning? That… you’ll have to find out yourself.[/p][p]And yes… we now have a [b]dancing ant[/b]. No questions, please.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44982818/c01e5ce3a4cbf473f4383b61a2c0e1c2bb858dd1.gif"][/img][/p][hr][/hr][p][/p][h3][b]6 - Weather That Changes Everything[/b][/h3][p]Rain may fall from time to time, but that’s just the beginning…[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44982818/9ca2866fb3f78843223b883144d7fd5a31352fdf.png"][/img]  [/p][p]You’ll also encounter [b]sandstorms[/b], floating spores that can contaminate you, and other weather effects depending on the biome. So yeah... stay alert out there.[/p][p][/p][hr][/hr][p][/p][h3][b]7 - What’s Next?[/b][/h3][p]There’s [i]much[/i] more to come, but it’s not quite ready 🐝[/p][p]We [i]wanted[/i] to release updates every 2–3 months, but this one took longer than expected because we tried to pack in [b]so much stuff[/b] all at once.[/p][p]Lesson learned, we’ll aim for [b]smaller, more frequent updates[/b] moving forward![/p][p]Some content even had to be cut from this version just so we could release it at all… but don’t worry. [b]Part Two[/b] of this update is coming [b]soon-ish[/b] (this year, we promise! No pressure 😅).[/p][p]We hope you enjoy all the new stuff![/p][p]Feel free to comment your thoughts on this update, and if you find any bugs (the bad kind), glitches, or weirdness, [b]please report it to us[/b]![/p][p][b]P.S. Has anyone seen my speaker? I left it around here somewhere…[/b][/p][p]
[/p]

tags.feature: The first thing you’ll notice is that we’ve given the entire game a visual overhaul!
New textures, new effects, more particles, more life, more chaos, the world of Honey Bee With Guns is more alive than ever.
Our main bee also got a much needed visual upgrade with a brand new model, making everything smoother and more expressive.
Bees can now carry and use weapons like mobile towers.
You can also equip multiple collected or unlocked weapons, pistols, SMGs, whatever you’ve got lying around.
This adds a whole new layer of tactical gameplay, custom loadouts, smarter defenses, and more dynamic battles.
We’ve made a bunch of improvements to hive management, rebalancing costs and resources, and giving the hive a brand-new look.
The UI has been reworked!
From the color palette to item layout and interaction flow, we’ve added little polish everywhere to improve your experience.
Other insects can now interact with you, sometimes as friends, sometimes as foes.
And yes… we now have a dancing ant.
Rain may fall from time to time, but that’s just the beginning…
You’ll also encounter sandstorms, floating spores that can contaminate you, and other weather effects depending on the biome.
Lesson learned, we’ll aim for smaller, more frequent updates moving forward!

notes.title: 🐝 Update 0.22: Sticky Ammo… 🐝
notes.content:
[h3]Hello, little bees! 🐝[/h3]
It took a while, but it's finally here! [b]Update 0.22[/b] brings a series of improvements and surprises to our hive.

If you want to avoid spoilers, just download the new update and jump right in! Just a reminder: this update is not compatible with previous versions.
Check out what’s new in the world of bees:

[h2]🍯 New Types of Honey[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44982818/61bdda1974a67437d5a684b4a875882ff4f737b7.gif[/img]

You can now collect special honey with unique abilities! Fire, Ice, and even Nuclear Honey are scattered across the world, each with their own effects! But… how do you get them? That’s a secret! 😉

[h3]🌳 Expanded Map[/h3]
The world just got bigger! Two mysterious new locations are now open for exploration:

🍄 [b]Infested Forest[/b] – A region full of secrets, fungi, and dangerous enemies. Proceed with caution!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44982818/e06465ceb33b279f4b09a7c992ca73ea1d74d837.png[/img]

🦋 [b]Butterfly Cove [/b]– A stunning, lively refuge… but maybe there’s more to it.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44982818/363eac3d399f83cfe2f3338f25ed0d65388341be.png[/img]

[h3]🔄 Improved Animations[/h3]
All bees have received animation upgrades for an even smoother and more immersive gameplay experience!

[h3]🍯 Honey Now Plays a Key Role![/h3]
Before, honey was just for upgrades and abilities. Now, it’s also essential for ammunition! Each type of honey has special effects that can be used against enemies—choose wisely!

[h3]🗡️ More Dynamic Battles[/h3]
Combat is more thrilling than ever! Feel the intensity of battle with new mechanics and interactive environments.

[h3]🔮 New Abilities & Customization[/h3]
With the arrival of new abilities, your bee can change its look! Want a protective helmet? Or maybe an unexpected effect from something… suspicious you drank? The possibilities are endless!

[h3]💬 A More Lively World[/h3]
The bees on the map are now interacting, commenting on past and present events. Pay close attention and you may discover valuable tips!

And this is just the beginning! Many more surprises are waiting for you in this update!

Update now and dive into this new adventure!
See you in the world of bees! 🐝🌟

notes.title: 🐝 Update 0.20: Taking Flight 🐝
notes.content:
Hello, hive guardians!🐝

How’s everyone doing? Today we’re rolling out our first update, packed with a swarm of fixes and improvements to make your Honey Bee experience sweeter (and a lot less buggy). Take a look at what’s new:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44982818/62c855c8225e3a6a2b524f4d267a93996dbe40d9.jpg[/img]

🧭 [b]Spatial Navigation Fix:[/b] Say goodbye to adventurous bees who were burrowing underground without permission. Now they know the sky’s the limit (and so is the ground!).

🤸 [b]Persistent Acrobats:[/b] We’ve resolved issues with spinning bees and those that were bailing mid-mission. Now, everything should be right where it belongs!

🕹️ [b]Gamepad Improvements:[/b] Navigation with the gamepad is now more intuitive. We also fixed a disappearing menu selector that used to play hide-and-seek on some screens.

🎶 [b]Music:[/b] We’ve made changes to the game’s sound system, so now the soundtrack plays continuously in each area without cutting off. We also optimized audio and environmental sounds to reduce loading stutters.

✨ [b]Performance Tweaks:[/b] First off, apologies if performance has been an issue. We’ve worked hard to optimize things, and we hope the game will run more smoothly on modest setups. However, if you still experience issues, don’t hesitate to let us know! 

Among the new features, we’ve added performance options for quality, shadows, grass, Vsync, and FSR. You can now adjust these in the game’s settings menu.

⚔️[b] Gravity Is Back:[/b] Enemy bees were forgetting that gravity existed, floating around at will. Now they’re ready for more action and less levitation!

🛒 [b]The Queen’s Shop Makeover: [/b]The queen told us her shop needed an upgrade, so we gave it a refresh. The store menu is now clearer and easier to navigate.


Thanks to everyone in the hive who helped us squash these bugs! Be sure to update the game, grab some nectar, and let’s get buzzing 🐝💪!
